name: Type Coercion
equipment: A computer with a JS runtime (a browser console, Node.js, or an online REPL like replit.com)
instructions: JavaScript sometimes converts types automatically -- this is called coercion.
console.log('5' + 3); // '53' -- number is converted to a string
console.log('5' - 3); // 2 -- string is converted to a number here instead
Type the example into a real file (or console/REPL), run it, then modify it until you understand why it behaves that way.
